answer: Newcomers enter a shared garden of verified work by locking a refundable stake, then complete small tasks checked by randomly assigned peers. Each verified task earns a signed receipt, and a whisper of reputation only grows from that hash-chained ledger of real output. An identity with no verified history stays on the ledge of low trust, unable to transact at full standing, so creating many fake identities costs a deposit and real work each time while buying no influence.
